media.alt_text:
A text message between President Biden and Trey

President Biden: If there’s a teacher who helped you believe in yourself, I’d like to hear a bit about them so I can join you in celebrating them.

Trey: Too many to count! Ms. Bonoguaro was my 3rd/4th grade teacher, and I was a super quiet, shy, and anxious kid in her class. She was so caring, and helped me come out of my shell and make some friends, and taught me that if I worked hard and used my brain, and opened myself up the people around me, I can accomplish anything. She changed my life, and I became a teacher so that I could help other the way she helped me.
 
President Biden: What a great teacher. I can’t let this day go without celebrating the one teacher that inspires me every day – my wife, Jill.
